name: Container ship
description: A 200 m gearless feeder / Panamax-style container ship with the house aft, 40 ft boxes stacked on hatch covers, bulbous bow and transom stern.

param_docs.loa_m: Length overall, metres (50-400). The hull, bulb, rudder and everything on deck fit inside it.
param_docs.beam_m: Moulded breadth, metres. Bridge wings run out to the ship's side.
param_docs.draught_m: Design draught, metres. The keel sits at minus this; the origin is the waterline amidships.
param_docs.depth_m: Moulded depth keel to main deck, metres. Freeboard = depth - draught.
param_docs.forecastle_height_m: How far the forecastle deck stands above the main deck, metres.
param_docs.house_front_frac: Where the front of the accommodation is, as a fraction of LOA from amidships (negative = aft).
param_docs.house_tiers: Decks in the accommodation block below the bridge (2.8 m each). More tiers = taller house.
param_docs.bays: Number of 40 ft container bays on deck, counted from the house forward. Bays that do not fit are dropped with a warning.
param_docs.rows: Containers across the ship in the widest bay. Forward bays lose rows where the hull narrows.
param_docs.tiers: Containers stacked high on the hatch covers. 0 = sailing empty (hatches only).
param_docs.stack_variation: 0-1: chance a stack is one box short, so the cargo does not look like a solid block.
param_docs.seed: Integer that decides box colours and short stacks. Same seed = same picture.
param_docs.cranes: Deck cranes (0 = gearless). Each one stands on the port side between bays, slews and luffs.
param_docs.superstructure_color: Accommodation, wheelhouse, bridge wings and breakwater colour, RGB 0-1.
param_docs.funnel_band_color: Company band on the funnel, RGB 0-1.
param_docs.container_colors: List of RGB colours the boxes are drawn from.

meta.name: Container ship (200 m feeder, gearless)
meta.notes: Proportions from typical 2,500-3,500 TEU Panamax-beam feeders (L/B 6.2, B/T 2.8). Single screw, single rudder.
